stories.title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort review – Wii Sports lives on in this effortlessly appealing collection of games
summary: Switch Sports is so beloved in my household that the release of Switch Sports Resort this week is the most anticipated gaming event of the year.
To be fair, my children are a bit young for Grand Theft Auto.Nintendo Switch Sports Resort brings three of the six sports back – tennis, bowling, and volleyball – alongside golf and basketball.
Then there are seven entirely new sports: boxing, table tennis, archery, thumb wrestling, skateboarding, jetski, and piloting a little prop plane.

stories.title: Show HN: Omnara – Open-source alternative to Claude Managed Agents
summary: A worker runs one iteration of the loop, either a model call or the tool calls it produced, then releases the agent and puts the next iteration on a queue in Postgres.

Agents waiting on a user, a tool or a retry don't hold a worker, so one worker can multiplex thousands of agents.Also unlike other harnesses, the machines that the workers (our agent loop) run on aren't where the agent runs its commands.

When I close my laptop, my agent sees the laptop went offline, pulls the latest changes to its cloud sandbox, and continues there.The entire codebase is open source at https://github.com/omnara-ai/omnara, and it’s self hostable, even on a single machine with docker compose.
